title: Binance reopens withdrawals after $6.3bn hack the FBI blames on North Korea
caption:
Crypto exchange Binance has begun reopening customer withdrawals after hackers stole about $6.3 billion, the largest crypto theft on record. The FBI says a North Korean group called TraderTraitor was behind the attack. Binance says it has replaced most of the stolen funds with its own money and that users will not bear the loss.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
